text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The minimum salary in Lithuania increased by 43 percent in September and was the highhest at $75 among the Baltic states ($68.84 in Latvia and $55.84 in Estonia).
- Lithuania has resumed timber imports from Russia. It is expected to import 140,000 cubic meters of timber before the end of the year.

- Lithuanian lawmakers will start considering a decree signed by President Algirdas Brazauskas to set a temporary sea border with Latvia that will take in most of the territory disputed with its northern neighbour and which is included in the agreement with Amoco and Opab.
